zh-CN.dailyProfitHint: 读取建筑财务账本的今日、昨日净额。构建时补齐原生账本依赖。
zh-CN.profitIndexHint: 读取商业或工业的利润指标及上次采样，不代表每日市政收入。

en-US.dailyProfitHint: Reads today's and yesterday's net totals from the building ledger. Builds include the native ledger dependency.
en-US.profitIndexHint: Reads the commercial or industrial profit index and its previous sample, not daily city revenue.
